scope: Real engine commands from new games or explicitly labelled replay checkpoints. Not browser, persistence, global optimality, balance, human or real-time-duration acceptance.

assumptions.funding: highest eligible stable pure-currency income per game month; clipped XP read from actual result
assumptions.comparison: Fixed candidate set only. Commands are logical engine calls, not DOM clicks or elapsed real time. Months already include work/recovery; do not charge gross stones again as months.
assumptions.checkpointAccounting: Separate ledger epoch; a full rollback is not resource income. HP is net change, not inferred gross damage.

failureRecovery.policy: base sword, no relic, reckless attacks, no added potions
